title: Protection and enrichment: how two different carbonaceous biofilm supports improve methane yield from encapsulated anaerobic microorganisms
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, 11,1542-1553
DOI: 10.1039/D4EW01043D, Paper
Annesh Borthakur, Mariah Dorner, Kendall Johnson, William A. Arnold, Paige J. Novak
This study shows that growing anaerobic microorganisms as biofilms on biochar and activated carbon before encapsulation improves methane production by increasing their viability and activity.
